name: pumi-office
description: Office as a UI theme: a pixel office you walk around, in Gather's style — a desk for every tab (or every pane), its agent at it, and the plugins in the lobby.

appearance.label: Mode
appearance.desc: The office by day (light), at night (dark), or as the system is.

desk_per_pane.label: One desk per pane
desk_per_pane.desc: Every pane of a split tab gets a desk of its own, with its agent sitting at it and its own screen, instead of one desk whose screen holds the whole tab. Sitting at one opens that pane.
